graph.title: Minnie Mouse (Brick Sketches)
notes: Port fix: catalogue plates/bricks expose only one 'stud.1' and one 'anti-stud.1' port even though they have many studs, and each port may be used only once. All stud/anti-stud joins therefore use null ports (allowed: 'Ports may be null'); every real multi-stud connection is kept as a joined edge. Ports are named only where each is used once (axle holes/axles, clip/bar). The reported multi-use ports are not real problems, they were a modelling limitation of single-port catalogue entries.

The model is a flat 12x16 plate-built picture with a built-in back frame and fold-out stand. Pieces are stacked, so most joins are stud/anti-stud; exact stud-by-stud positions are not recoverable from the isometric pictures, so each piece is joined to the piece(s) it visibly sits on (best interpretation).

The four 4x8 white base plates (b1, b13, b14, b22) are not visibly joined to each other directly; they are held together by the pieces layered over them (blue plates, tiles, back frame). Which base plate each overlying tile sits on is approximate.
Back frame (steps 21-25): 1x16 bricks, 1x12 brick and 1x12 plates attach to the underside of the base; which base plates each frame piece touches is approximate.

Step 24: placement of the 2x3 rounded plate with hole (b75) and the two bar-handle plates (b76, b77) relative to the 1x3/1x4 plates is interpreted from the picture; clip connectors at the ends of the stand legs (b82, b83) clip onto the bars of b76/b77 (revolute).
Stand leg (step 26): two curved elbows joined by the red axle extender, an 11L axle in each free end, and a clip-end connector at the far end of each axle.

Step 29 checker sub-assembly (red round plate 2x2 with axle hole + 2 tan 1x1 plates + 2 red quarter-round plates) sits on the first red round plate (b36), which sits on the centre stud of the yellow 2x2 plate (b10).

Repeats: 'foot' = round brick + foot pad on frame corners (2 on each 1x16 brick); 'eyes' = half-round 2x4 with two curved eye tiles (step 34); 'bow' = heart plate with two white round plates (step 36). Edges inside repeats that name b110, b111/b112, b113/b114, b107 record what sits on them; attach overrides redirect copy 2 (or copies 3-4) to the other target.
Step 38's two white 1x1 plates (b108, b109) have no clear location in the pictures; they are placed on the lower white half-round (b49) as a guess.

New part types added for pieces not in the catalogue: 6284572, 6195358, 383221, 4159553, 6170390, 6066342, 6276193, 6315482, 6132201, 6126050. The name/colour of 6170390 (red quarter-round 1x1 plate) and 6276193 (red heart plate) are inferred from the images.
Inventory check: all piece counts match the parts list (e.g. 4560181 x10, 306924 x10, 6284572 x8, 6276193 x4, 6170390 x4).
